descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A2 · P2 · 无障碍

状态和错误不播报：报错、无搜索结果、Ask AI 的回答、「Listening…」都不读出来；开关没有选中 / 按下状态

票：TFA-94745 等 · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：EFS/S22, OAT-03/S22, TC-03/S22, TC-15/S19, TC-23/S18, TC-09/S23

思路 / Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S23 「视觉车道：Pre-Round 标签页、打开的编辑器（两个模式）、摘要失败提示和 Generate 禁用原因上的 axe、手机宽度和 WebKit」 Visual lane: axe, phone widths and WebKit on the Pre-Round tab, the open editor (both modes), the summary-failed message and the disabled Generate reason

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 The Pre-Round tab has two boxes: the dictation (most of the screen) and Important Points (TC-12).（UAT TC-10；TFA-92588 How it works 1；TFA-92590 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr; TFA-92590 in progress
  • T2 Tapping the Pre-Round notepad opens a fullscreen editor, as in Vikram's existing app, not a fixed small box.（TFA-92588 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • T4 The summary-failed state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's style (never a blank screen, crash, raw error pop-up or invented content), loses nothing typed or dictated, appears only af …（TFA-94745 AC 1；TFA-94745 AC 2；TFA-94745 AC 3；TFA-94745 AC 4；TFA-94745 AC 5；UAT Empty & Failure States；UAT 3.5）
  • T5 The pre-round flow and its summary-failed state work on web, iOS and Android.（TFA-94745 AC 6）

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit) profiles plus desktop; Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, editor closed and open with a long text; the S12 failed state

When Run axe and the visual checks on each screen

Then No serious or critical WCAG 2 A/AA violations; the editor dialog, notes box, points box, Dictate and Save Note have accessible names; the error is announced (role=alert); the editor fills the viewport in both modes (Nursing Home included: its editor box equals the viewport), the dictation box is the larger box, Save Note and the error stay visible, nothing …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core results (zero serious or critical) and the visual lane's overflow/covered/truncated/tap checks; the editor bounding box against the viewport (as chart.spec.ts does for Hospital); the box-height ratio feeds Q8. iOS keyboard behaviour is manual. Merged from the former S23 (axe) and S24 (phone widths and WebKit)

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S23 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-10.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92588 ready for pr；TFA-92590 in progress；TFA-94745 ready for qa

医院预查房摘要失败时读屏用户听不到提示（没有 alert），养老院全屏编辑器打开时不会被读成对话框，返回按钮没有名字，部分文字对比度不够。

A screen-reader user is not told when the Hospital pre-round summary fails, because the message has no alert role. The Nursing Home full-screen editor opens without being announced as a dialog, its back button has no name, and some text fails contrast.

依据：allure 52a4909a, visual lane: 135 passed, 39 failed across desktop, iPhone 15 and Pixel 7. The layout parts pass: the editor fills the viewport, the dictation box is the larger one, Save Note, the error and the Generate reason stay visible, and Generate's reason is a role=alert.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-10/S23

Visual lane: axe, phone widths and WebKit on the Pre-Round tab, the open editor (both modes), the summary-failed message and the disabled Generate reason

Tickets: TFA-92588 Pre-Rounding Summary (ready for pr); TFA-92590 Important Points (in progress); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: partly）：preround.spec.ts: processed charts (tab, editor open with the S01 text) and S12 failed charts (preRoundError seeded) in both modes: axe, names (dialog, notes, points, Dictate, Save Note), editor box vs viewport, dictation box > points box (ratio recorded for Q8), Save Note / error visible, error announced, Encounter with the disabled-Generate reason announced. [2026-10-14 review] Layout judges overflow, covered, truncated and tap (phones) on every capture: the oracle names all four (only overflow was judged before). — iOS keyboard behaviour is manual per the oracle.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 135 judged check(s) passed, 39 failed. Editor fills the viewport in both modes; the dictation box is the larger box (ratio recorded for Q8); Save Note, the error and the disabled-Generate reason stay visible; Generate is disabled on the failed charts and its reason is a role=alert in both modes.

产品问题：Hospital: the summary-failed message ('The reviewed note is saved, but its structured summary needs another attempt. Tap Save Note to retry.') is not announced — no role=alert on the Pre-Round tab or in the editor (oracle: the error is announced, role=alert; NH has it). Nursing Home: the full-screen pre-round editor is not a dialog (no role=dialog, no name), so a screen-reader user is not told a new screen opened (oracle: editor dialog … named). Also NH back button unnamed and contrast failures.

只记录的格子（recorded）：NH editor boxes are named only by their placeholders (recorded for a person, WCAG 3.3.2; not judged — the oracle is axe). Layout checks the oracle names (overflow, covered, truncated, tap) pass on every state since the review.

证据：附了 7 个；没附 1 个：

  • visual/evidence/TC-10_S23 — 目录（63 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
